query: SELECT extract(epoch FROM clock.observed_at)::float8 AS "observed_at!", extract(epoch FROM oldest.expires_at)::float8 AS "oldest?" FROM (SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at) AS clock LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT expires_at FROM http_idempotency_records WHERE expires_at <= clock.observed_at ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 1 ) AS oldest ON true
